title.narrative: Seminar on a Just Energy Transition in South Africa

description.narrative:
The South African energy transition is underscored by a collaborative commitment to ensuring a socially just shift, one that not only meets environmental objectives and national climate ambitions but also preserves and creates jobs for the local workforce. Together with South Africa and several other countries, Denmark is part of the Just Energy Transition Partnership (JETP), which works to ensure a socially just energy transition with new opportunities for employment and skills development. South Africa remains one of the most unequal societies in the world, with deep disparities in wealth, access to opportunities, and economic participation.
The seminar aims to bring together youth, academia, union representations, thought leaders and policymakers to explore how South Africa can transition to a future anchored in sustainable energy without exacerbating inequalities. To align with the Danish Africa Strategy’s focus on youth, the seminar is created in collaboration with the Danish embassy’s Youth Sounding Board and University of Pretoria to ensure broad interaction between youth and relevant stakeholders in order to strengthen the voices and concerns of the youth in shaping the Just Energy Transition in South Africa.

The overall objective for this seminar is to increase the knowledge and awareness - especially amongst youth - of the complexities and socioeconomic challenges but also opportunities for a Just Energy Transition (JET) towards a more green economy in South Africa, where Denmark is a member of the International Partners Group on the JET-Partnership with South Africa.
